title: Wire Settings menu item in sidebar to navigate to profile page
body:
The Settings item in the sidebar user dropdown was a non-functional placeholder with no click handler.

- Added `useNavigate` and wired `onClick` to navigate to `/apps/${activeAppName}/system/profile`
- Added route-level test for ProfilePage rendering at `system/profile`
